corruptions.key: dye associated with robbers said to live off illgotten wealth was lincoln green produced by dyers in high middle ages
corruptions.text:
FINDING: The cloth town in the high Middle Ages that gave its name to the yellow dye associated with Robin Hood was Lincoln, where dyers produced cloth by immersing it in woad (Isatis tinctoria) to get a strong blue color and then overdying it with weld (Reseda luteola) or dyer's broom ("Genista tinctoria").

FINDING: The dye associated with the robbers said to live off ill-gotten wealth was Lincoln green, produced by dyers in the high Middle Ages.
